title: What's New: Financial Analytics (2025 release wave 2)

chapters.title: PowerBI for finance and cash flow analytics
Deferrals analysis and report layout modernization
New deferral line pages and finance documentation
Finance reporting documentation and analytics landing page

features.name: Dynamic date headers in financial reporting
features.description: New capability to include actual dates in column headers of financial reports instead of relative period labels like 'current period'. When both text and date are shown, the date appears in parenthesis; when only the date component is present, it displays standalone.

features.name: Additional reporting currency support in financial reports
features.description: Ability to run financial reports that show amounts in both local currency and additional reporting currency in separate columns. Column definitions now include a field to enable displaying amounts in additional reporting currency.
caveats: Requires additional currency to be set up in the system to display values

features.name: Improved row definition editing in financial reporting
features.description: Users can now edit row definition descriptions directly from the card view, and row definitions can be edited in Excel. When adding a single GL account to a row definition, the description is auto-completed from the account name.

features.name: GL account name change notifications in financial reporting
features.description: When a GL account name is changed, users receive a notification reminding them to check if that account is used in any financial reports where the name should also be updated.

features.name: Show less/show more improvements in financial reporting
features.description: Productivity improvement to financial reporting interface that hides unnecessary fields by default in report options, giving users more screen space to view the actual report content.

features.name: Late payment analysis report for receivables
features.description: New PowerBI report that analyzes late payments on receivables using bubble charts. The visualization shows outstanding amounts on one axis, average days late on another, and bubble size represents payment amount. Customers with large late payments and high lateness appear in the upper right quadrant.

features.name: Historical average collection period trend in PowerBI
features.description: Enhanced average collection period report in PowerBI now includes historical trend data, allowing users to see collection periods over time and identify patterns in accumulated accounts receivable.

features.name: Deferral analysis for posted and upcoming deferrals
features.description: Enhanced ability to analyze both posted deferrals and upcoming non-posted deferrals across sales, purchase invoices, and GL level. Users can now see both historical and future deferral impacts.
caveats: Previously only posted deferrals could be analyzed

features.name: Word and Excel layouts for deferral reports
features.description: Deferral reports now support modern Word and Excel layouts in addition to RDLC. Users can switch between formats and set their preferred default format on the report request page.

features.name: In-client documentation for deferrals reporting
features.description: Added teaching tips and links to documentation articles within the deferral reports to help users understand how to use the reports and what they are designed for.

features.name: Excel layout analysis across deferrals
features.description: Excel layouts now enable analysis across all deferrals whether for sales, purchase, or GL, with ability to slice, dice, filter, and customize layouts to upload as defaults.

features.name: New deferral lines pages
features.description: Added three new pages for deferral lines covering sales, purchase, and GL to analyze deferral lines across all unposted documents. Previously required viewing deferral schedules individually in each invoice.
caveats: Pages are for unposted documents only

features.name: Comprehensive finance reports documentation
features.description: New complete documentation of finance reports covering VAT, cost accounting, deferrals, consolidations, and intercompany with both learn content and in-client teaching tips, addressing previously undocumented features.
